projects.name: Northstar ERP Modernization
projects.description: Replatforming Beacon Industrial Group's core manufacturing and finance processes onto a modern ERP suite, including plant data integration, procurement workflow redesign, and a phased cutover across four production sites.

projects.name: Atlas Commerce Platform
projects.description: Delivering a unified commerce platform for Fenwick & Cole Retail spanning storefront, order management, and loyalty services, with a mobile-first customer experience and real-time inventory visibility.

projects.name: Horizon Analytics Migration
projects.description: Migrating Calder Energy Partners' legacy reporting warehouse to a cloud analytics platform, consolidating field telemetry, asset maintenance, and regulatory reporting into a single governed data model.

projects.name: Meridian Customer Portal
projects.description: Building a self-service customer portal for Solstice Financial Group covering account servicing, secure document exchange, and advisor scheduling, integrated with existing policy administration systems.

projects.name: Summit Integration Program
projects.description: Establishing an integration backbone connecting Vantage Health Systems' scheduling, billing, and clinical records platforms, currently paused pending revised data-governance sign-off from the customer's compliance office.

projects.name: Cascade Field Service Rollout
projects.description: Delivered a mobile field-service scheduling and work-order solution for Ironwood Utilities Co. field crews, replacing paper-based dispatch with route-optimized, offline-capable mobile assignments.

projects.name: Pinnacle Procurement Suite
projects.description: Rolling out a strategic sourcing and supplier-collaboration suite for Beacon Industrial Group to standardize procurement across newly acquired business units, with tight interdependencies on the Northstar ERP program.
